# Aura TV

> Aura TV is an iPhone and iPad IPTV player for user-provided M3U playlists, Xtream-compatible credentials, and EPG/XMLTV guide data.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://auratv.mesikalabs.com/)
- [Blog](https://auratv.mesikalabs.com/blog/)
- [IPTV player explainer](https://auratv.mesikalabs.com/blog/iptv-player-without-channels/)
- [Support](https://auratv.mesikalabs.com/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://auratv.mesikalabs.com/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://auratv.mesikalabs.com/terms/)

## Product Positioning

- Primary category: IPTV player for iOS.
- Core search intents: IPTV player iPhone, M3U player iOS, Xtream IPTV player, EPG/XMLTV guide player, bring your own playlist IPTV app.
- Aura TV is player-only. It does not provide channels, playlists, broadcaster accounts, sports packages, movies, series, catalogs, or content access.
- Users are responsible for the sources and media they add.
